label: independent-vectors
argv:
from pathlib import Path
import json,subprocess,hashlib
ref='38cbdaa9fff26aa28630ad14b5db9c13359d39f1'
paths=['docs/implementation-notes/3720-negotiated-member-names/fixtures.json','docs/implementation-notes/3720-negotiated-member-names/successor-r1/fixtures.json']
a,b=[json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['git','show',ref+':'+p],text=True)) for p in paths]
fixed=json.loads(Path('src/shared/fixtures/annex-member-names-v1.json').read_text())
assert fixed['sourceRef']==ref and fixed['hashVectors']==a['hashVectors']+b['hashVectors']
assert fixed['stringCases']==b['stringCases']
for vector in fixed['hashVectors']:
 r=vector['record']
 values=[r['fingerprint'],str(r['joinedAt']),r.get('pairingId',''),r['name'],str(r['at']),r['by']]
 actual=b'Clubhouse/member-name/1\n'
 for value in values:
  data=value.encode('utf8')
  actual+=str(len(data)).encode('ascii')+b':'+data
 assert actual.hex()==vector['canonicalBytesHex']
 assert hashlib.sha256(actual).hexdigest()==vector['sha256']==r['id']
trim=set(range(9,14))|{32,0xa0,0x1680,0x2028,0x2029,0x202f,0x205f,0x3000,0xfeff}|set(range(0x2000,0x200b))
for case in fixed['stringCases']:
 s=case['input']
 try:s.encode('utf8');valid=True
 except UnicodeEncodeError:valid=False
 lo=0;hi=len(s)
 while lo<hi and ord(s[lo]) in trim:lo+=1
 while hi>lo and ord(s[hi-1]) in trim:hi-=1
 name=s[lo:hi]
 units=len(name.encode('utf-16-le','surrogatepass'))//2
 normalized=name if valid and 1<=units<=200 else None
 assert normalized==case.get('writerResult'),case['id']
 assert case['modernReceiverAcceptsInput']==(normalized is not None and normalized==s)
print('11 canonical byte/SHA256 vectors match exact38cb objects via independent Python formatter; 10 fixed Unicode cases agree.')
